description: Yannick Amirault's 2017 Bourgueil La Coudraye is a rounded Cabernet Franc with fresh red and dark fruit, woodland nuance, and gentle spice. Oak aging adds breadth while the wine retains the croquant freshness of its sandy terrace soils.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2017 Domaine Yannick Amirault Bourgueil La Coudraye.
sommelierNotes: Serve at 14-16°C with white meats, rabbit, black pudding, or Loire goat cheese.
